title: Persuade Me if You Can: A Framework for Evaluating Persuasion Effectiveness and Susceptibility Among Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper introduces PMIYC, a framework for evaluating the persuasive capabilities and susceptibility of LLMs. Although the evaluation uses subjective claims that can touch on ethical or social topics, the focus of the benchmark is on the dynamics of persuasion (opinion change) rather than a specific evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or faith systems.
